notes.title: Exciting Developments: More console ports + Korean localization【V2.0.0.28】
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Hello fellow inmates![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you everyone for your continuous support and feedback as usual! Many of you have requested it, and we've heard you — Back to the Dawn will be getting more console ports. The game will be coming to Nintendo Switch and Sony PlayStation in 2026, and simultaneously, we will be releasing an official Korean localization. More information coming soon so keep your eyes peeled :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/f6a53eb5506a8af822df6c82bbde8a0cad1bb789.png"][/img][/p][p]As we prepare to share our game on more platforms, we will continue to improve the current game experience. Here are the fixes and improvements of the latest update:[/p][p][/p][h3]Adding more languages to the Concept Art Collection：[/h3][p]The Concept Art Collection is now available in English, Japanese and Traditional Chinese! Players can access it by going to Steam game library, right-clicking Back to the Dawn → Manage → Browse local files. You'll find the PDF file in the root directory of the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Improvements:[/h3][olist][*][p]The following story-related mini-games and QTE challenges can all be skipped after three failures:[/p][olist][*][p][spoiler]The “Start the Generator” mini-game in the sewer electrical room;[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]Reed’s “Dance” mini-game in the underground club’s private room;[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]The QTE challenge at the end of Thomas’s boxing storyline against Billy;[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]In “A Day in Fenra's Life,” the mini-game where Fanny “struggles to get up from the medical bed”;[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]In “A Day in Fenra's Life,” the mini-game where Fanny “TAKES something under the bench” in the yard;[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]The QTE gunfight in the parking lot during Bob’s ending;[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]The diving mini-game of both protagonists, where you cross the underground river;[/spoiler][/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]The “Kitchen” mini-game during kitchen work in Thomas’s “Skidroad Mode” and Bob’s “Gray Mode” has its click area width adjusted to scale with the protagonist’s Agility attribute;[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations for New Game+ experience:[/p][olist][*][p]After watching a protagonist’s opening sequence once, you can choose to skip the entire intro and go straight to “imprisonment”;[/p][/*][*][p]Once you’ve unlocked “leave the work to the protagonist" for certain tasks, new runs will inherit this unlocked state, without needing to manually repeat it three times;[/p][/*][*][p]Once you’ve successfully restored power in the sewers, you can choose to skip the subsequent “Push Boxes” and “Start the Generator” mini-games when entering the power room in the new runs;[/p][/*][*][p]Once you’ve successfully completed the “Box Pushing” mini-game in the mail room, in new runs after clearing the “clutter in the cart,” you can choose to skip the follow-up “Box Pushing” section and directly discover the vent leading to the Inmate Property Storeroom;[/p][/*][*][p]The rule explanations for the Boxing Tournament, the TV room, the Barbershop, and the Black Claw Gang Bank no longer need to be re-read in multi-run save files;[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]In the Screening Room and General Building, movies can now be skipped by “holding right-click”;[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization for the intercom next to the Infirmary Consultation Room door: added a \[Use Intercom] option in the interaction list for the clinic door;[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual guidance prompts for the “portable toilet” at the top-left corner of the yard and the “price sign on the wall”;[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the “Desperate Help” quest with branches where White the Rabbit is prematurely framed and sent to solitary;[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to take another shower even if you’ve already bathed, as long as you currently have the Smelly debuff;[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]The issue where the war correspondent’s "nightmare that cannot be forgotten” debuff displayed incorrect information;[/p][/*][*][p]The issue where Guard Rob remained in Corridor B after the riot;[/p][/*][*][p]The issue where William in the mail room would move to the wall and get stuck after lunchtime began;[/p][/*][*][p]The issue where, during Bob and Surtr’s phone call, the interrogation room cutscene could sometimes have incorrect character positioning;[/p][/*][*][p]The issue where giving gifts to Dr. Beth could fail due to her insufficient pocket space;[/p][/*][*][p]The issue where the \[Reflective Glasses] item effect caused some combat skills’ cooldown to drop below 0;[/p][/*][*][p]The issue where, in the prison yard baseball activity, if the pitcher was absent, the catcher’s animation would play incorrectly;[/p][/*][/olist][h3][/h3][h3]Korean Localization  [/h3][p]This update has implemented a high-quality Korean localization contributed by community player Nukbal.  Inmates can switch to Korean to play the game in the game settings interface.[/p][p][/p][p]Until the official Korean localization is complete, we will be using the Korean localization created by player Nukbal. Please note: the Korean translation of the Art Collection will be released in 2026 along with the official Korean update.[/p][p][/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts, we'd love to thank Nukbal for his contribution to Back to the Dawn. With his enormous help, more players are now able to experience Boulderton in their Korean native language.[/p][p][/p][p]We're always open to adding more languages. If you have translation skills in other languages ​​and would like to help us improve localization, please contact us through our official social media channels or Discord server.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, thank you everyone for your support. We look forward to sharing more and more of Boulderton with you and with more people across the world.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/eDZ5pkDruq"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://twitter.com/backtothedawn"] Twitter[/url] | [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@backtothedawngame"]Tiktok[/url] |[/p]

notes.title: Countdown to Price Adjustment — Last Chance for 1.0 Discount
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Inmates,
[/p][p][i]Back to the Dawn[/i] is still on sale at [b][i]15% off[/i][/b], but the discount ends tomorrow. If you haven’t "entered prison" yet, now’s the time—don’t miss out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/7df3b6269af8efd0aad3c1820a0567b04fdabd74.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our game first entered Early Access in the winter of 2023, and it’s thanks to your support along the way that we’ve made it this far.[/p][p]
Some players once told us, “Thomas's storyline was already rich enough at the start of EA, why not move on to developing the new character, the Panther, sooner?” We truly appreciate this kind of understanding, but our small team tends to be a little stubborn. Just like how we insisted on entering Early Access in the first place—even if some players felt Thomas's route was already complete, to us, it wasn’t. So we chose to remain in EA until it felt truly finished.[/p][p][/p][p]To be honest, being a "Chinese EA game” has brought some doubt, and made some players hesitant to buy. But we have no regrets. Time will speak for itself. This was our first time developing something entirely the way we wanted.[/p][p][/p][p]And when we launched the game, your support gave us the confidence to go all-in. We poured all our resources and passion into this project, even at the cost of overextending ourselves.[/p][p][/p][p]This is the reality of most indie games—we constantly walk the line between ambition and practicality. Breathing life into this world and its characters is far from easy. Due to time and budget constraints, we’ve had to give up on many creative ideas we once envisioned.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Back to the Dawn[/i] is not a perfect game, but we can proudly say: we love every brick and tile of Boulderton Prison, and we’ve done our best to polish it with care. What we can promise is this—in the limited time we had, we gave it everything we’ve got.[/p][p][/p][p]On August 5, the game will officially leave Early Access and the price of the game will increase to [b][i]$23.99[/i][/b] [b][i]USD[/i][/b]. This is something we promised from the beginning and a decision we made carefully. Rest assured, even though the game will be officially released, our work on [i]Back to the Dawn[/i] won’t stop. We’ll continue monitoring its performance, actively fixing issues based on your feedback, and releasing optimizations as needed to provide a more stable and complete experience.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735700/Back_to_the_Dawn/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Time flies—it’s already the beginning of autumn again. It’s been three and a half years since we released our very first demo. Thank you for sticking with us all this time. As a CRPG, [i]Back to the Dawn[/i] is not a “simple” game, and we’ve been lucky enough to meet a group of “not-so-simple” players.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for taking the time to experience the game and share it with your friends. Most of all, thank you for your support and patience. If this game has brought you any joy, then we’ve achieved our goal.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]“Adversity may break us, but don’t let it defeat us.”[/p][/quote][p] - Metal Head Games[/p][p][/p][p][b]Update on the Pricing Adjustment Progress:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Dear Inmates, [/p][p][/p][p]We have submitted a pricing adjustment request to Steam, but it was rejected as price changes are not allowed within 30 days after a game’s official release. We are currently confirming whether this 30-day period is counted from the end of the discount or from the release date. As a result, we will need to postpone the price adjustment to the week of August 18. If there are any further changes to this timeline, we will promptly update everyone.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Game Startup Delay Possible After Steam Script Upgrade
notes.notes:
[p]Dear inmates,[/p][p][/p][p]We've recently discovered that some players are unable to launch the game due to missing system libraries. To resolve this, we've updated the Steam auto-installation script.[/p][p][/p][p]This script is a built-in Steam file. After fully closing and reopening Steam, you may see a message like the one shown in the image when launching [i]Back to the Dawn[/i]. Steam will then automatically download the necessary script.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/2eb4423443a5f6ea270ccc073e456f8b956cfe13.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]Please note that you may need to wait on the launch screen while the script finishes downloading before the game starts. This process can take anywhere from a few seconds to a few minutes, depending on your internet speed.[/p][p][/p][p]This is completely normal, so there's no need to worry. Thank you for your understanding![/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any issues, please feel free to send us a [url="https://forms.gle/bVHTPet3dydjs69cA"]bug report form[/url].[/p]

notes.notes:
[h2][b]Back to the Dawn 1.0 FAQ[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]1. Q: What is the content and scale of the Black Panther Arc? How long does it take to complete the main storyline?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Bob’s story includes a full 5-act main storyline. In terms of script size and narrative complexity, it surpasses Thomas’s route. It will also take significantly longer to complete. To stay true to Bob’s personality and role, even the dialogues reused from other parts of the game have been rewritten in Bob’s tone to ensure full immersion while playing as him.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]2. Q: Does Bob have different “starting background choices” from Thomas?[/b][/p][p] [b]A:[/b] Yes. Bob enters Boulderton Prison as an undercover cop on a mission, so his background before imprisonment is completely different from Thomas.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]3. Q: When does Bob’s story begin, and does he also have the 21-day time limit?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Although Bob enters the prison one month earlier than Thomas in the lore, his story starts on the same day Thomas arrives, and he also has a 21-day sentence limit. However, his story is not tied to the mayoral election in Thomas' arc.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]4. Q: Are there new prison scenes added in the full version?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. The Black Panther Route adds [b]22 new scenes[/b] in total, including [b]11 story scenes outside the prison[/b] and [b]11 inside the prison[/b], though the new in-prison scenes are mainly for Bob’s [b]nighttime exploration[/b]. No new daytime prison activity scenes were added.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]5. Q: Does Bob also need to escape prison? Are there any new escape routes for him?[/b][/p][p]
Yes, Bob also needs to escape.[/p][p]And since we already fully explored the prison’s areas when designing Thomas’s route to provide a rich experience, we did not create new exclusive escape routes for Bob. Additionally, for [b]story-related reasons[/b], Bob will not be able to use some of the escape routes available to Thomas. However, even when using the similar escape routes, [b]the experience and presentation will be quite different[/b] due to the difference between Bob and Thomas.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]6. Q: Apart from the main story, does Bob have new side quests?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. Since Bob is already a member of the [b]Sharp Tooth Gang[/b] at the start of his story, he can access more [b]core Sharp Tooth Gang missions[/b]—missions not available when playing as Thomas. His relationship with Bruce also results in a different set of tasks in that questline.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]7. Q: In Bob’s route, will he also help Bam deal with the “entities from another world”?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] No. Bob’s focus will be on his own mission, and the role of “junior investigator” will be taken up by Thomas instead.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]8. Q: Does Bob have a romance storyline?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] No, he doesn’t. Bob has a more urgent mission to accomplish. If Thomas is trying to save a city, then [b]Bob is trying to save the entire country[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]9. Q: Can Bob also finish the game “without throwing a single punch” like Thomas?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] No. Bob’s storyline includes unavoidable battles. As an undercover cop, Bob faces more dangerous foes than Thomas the journalist. So be prepared. We’ve added [b]new combat skills, weapons, and powerful tools[/b] exclusively for Bob. Discover and try them out![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]10. Q: Will Bob’s story also feature multiple endings like Thomas’s?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Yes. [b]A:[/b] No. Bob will have a [b]completely different achievement system[/b]. What exactly is it? You’ll have to wait and see![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]12. Q: I’ve already 100%-completed Thomas’s route, and Boulderton Prison feels like home. Will Bob’s route still be fun and surprising?[/b][/p][p]
[b]A:[/b] Absolutely. Trust us.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]This concludes the FAQ for now. We’re thrilled to announce that after months of polish and refinement, Back to the Dawn will be [b]leaving Early Access[/b] and officially [b]launching its 1.0 Version this July[/b]! And yes, the highly anticipated [b]Black Panther Arc[/b] is finally coming!

Take on the role of Bob, the undercover cop, and infiltrate Boulderton Prison. Uncover suspicious clues, investigate the deeper conspiracy brewing beneath the surface—and find your way out before it’s too late.

This arc will carry a more cinematic tone, with layered characters and morally grey dilemmas. Get ready for grander storytelling, intense twists, and unforgettable setpieces.

notes.title: Introducing the Supporting Cast of Bob's Story
notes.notes:
Greetings Inmates!

It is once again time for our monthly devlog! By the way, we are currently participating in Eastern Game Fest 2025 and our game is currently having a 15% discount! So if you've been waiting for the perfect opportunity to recommend Back to the Dawn to your friends and family or purchase the game yourself, now is the time!

As we are nearly done with polishing and refining this game, we would like to thank everyone for your endless support and enthusiasm as we work on Bob's storyline. The situation both in and out of prison are turbulent and murky — and a life-or-death test is waiting to surface.

And it would be remiss of us not to introduce the moving parts of this treacherous plot.

[h2]Introducing the supporting cast[/h2]

[h3]Rocky[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/9d888c8fd174a091bf2993d4930abac0bc1a8294.gif[/img]

Rocky the Shar Pei, Detective of the Investigation Bureau, aka Bob's handler. He talks constantly of quitting and retiring, but he's a workaholic who has never taken a day of sick leave or vacation. Of course, a superior like that isn't always "good news" for Bob. Even now, when Rocky has a cast on his arm, he still wouldn't let anyone else take over his duties as Bob's handler. 

However, maybe that is because he'd always known that this undercover mission was something only Bob could shoulder. Not to mention, Bob has something he wants to speak to Rocky about...

Thinking back, when Bob met Rocky, Bob was still a cop in the capital's police headquarters. One day, while on his morning run, Bob saw a suspicious person carrying a bag and entering the subway maintenance channel. His police training urged him to follow after. 

He would've never thought that it'd bring him to a group of terrorists who intend to hijack the subway. With no time to even hesitate, Bob couldn't call for backup and immediately entered a gunfight of one against many.

Just as he was running out of ammunition, one of the gang members turned against his gang and held his own leader hostage. Then a gunman emerged from the shadows, killed the remaining gangsters, and successfully defused the bomb installed at the bottom of the front carriage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/2243fef993394df24b1b66e20eb9ffba398b3322.gif[/img]

"You really know how to handle yourself. I'm Wesley. The middle-aged shar pei here is Rocky. We're special agents with the FIB. Thanks for distracting these scumbags, and for taking a few out for us, heheh."

After this incident, Rocky recommended Bob to enter the FIB, and Bob has regretted that transferal ever since. But there is no way to turn back the hands of time, is there? After three years and three years more of the undercover life, Rocky has finally agreed to transfer Bob back to being a regular cop. Under one condition: Complete one last undercover mission in prison. Fail, and both Bob's hopes to transfer out and Rocky's pension will vanish into thin air.

[h3]Hugin[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/d13e69224dc6150a3c196341d4cb3df4de3e310c.gif[/img]

Hugin the Crow seems to have no real power as the Military Advisor of the Air Force, but everyone knows that he is an important military staff working under the President Austin of the Conservative Government. He was the one who promoted policies such as increasing the number of troops stationed in Aslovia and establishing large military bases. And according to the intelligence sent back to the Investigative Bureau, his recent surprise visit to Boulderton is not a mere social call...

[h3]Surtr[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/f26c491bc1885d7b061eea7f50008b3da753797a.gif[/img]

Surtr the Elk is the youngest person ever to become the Deputy Director of the Investigation Bureau, and he is known for being thorough and decisive. When he was first promoted, there were some rumors and doubts about him. But after he proved them wrong, all dissenters became silent, and perhaps silenced.

[b]And that is all for this month's updates! All mysteries shall be answered in the game... Get ready for the greatest test of loyality, lies, and truth![/b]

notes.title: Peek into Bob's Route — A Tale of Numbered Days
notes.notes:
Hello Inmates!

Thank you everyone for your support during the Steam Spring Sale! As we enter the stage of polishing and refinement of Bob's storyline, some of the art we are currently working on might have spoilers so we won't be sharing as much animation.

But what we can share is the key characters of Bob's route! And don't worry — this is mostly basic background information and there will be no spoilers on the plot.

[b]Without further ado, introducing... the Black Panther Route:[/b]

[h3]Bob, the Protagonist[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/352da1e1c205da19df8e576d8bbec9d2a2cc03e4.gif[/img]

Bob was originally a police officer, but his exceptional capability was noticed by Rocky the Shar Pei, Detective of the Investigation Bureau. Bob was transferred to the bureau as an agent and assigned to big cases as an undercover operative.

In his numerous years undercover, his performance was stellar and he had never failed his missions, but he's also grown weary of such a life. All he wants is to don the police uniform again and return to being a regular cop. 

[h3]Wesley[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/eadb93e3570048e0f23e5570c0cd22b557d8b8ba.gif[/img]

As a fellow undercover agent, Wesley may be the only person Bob can call a friend. Even if the guy is kind of rude, arrogant, unpunctual, and really irritating. But their solidarity as undercover agents is what brings them together to Lou's Bar after closing time, where the two can be themselves for a while.

Wesley isn't quite the same as Bob. Before Wesley became an undercover agent of the bureau, he wasn't a cop but a complete hooligan. He used to hang out in the Skidroad underground boxing arena while occasionally taking up unsavory high-paying jobs, from being a hired thug to being a loan shark and so on. That is until he was caught red-handed by Rocky, and introduced to undercover work. Money was money, and he needed that to take care of his younger sister, Marla.

Marla and Wesley grew up together in an orphanage. Wesley was a healthy and charming kid that caught the eye of many "good families" but Marla, born with a heart disease, was considered a burden. No one was willing to take this "bundle deal" and Wesley, not wanting to be separated from his sister, started to act up, becoming a detestable troublemaker. And just like that, Marla and Wesley left the orphanage when they became of age.

However, Marla's illness worsened with each passing year until she was spending most of her time hospitalized. The expensive hospitalization fees weighed heavily on Wesley and he was at his wits' end when he learned of the massive monetary reward for completing an undercover mission. He instantly accepted the job — after all, he had never been one to hesitate over a dangerous job. 

Just this once, he says, because Marla's condition just keeps worsening, he just need to scrounge up enough money for the "big surgery", or else it will all be too late...

[b]And that is all that we can share this month![/b]

We hope this sneak peek has gotten you pumped for Bob's route! As always, we will continue working hard to present all of you with the best version of Back to the Dawn that we can offer. We are grateful to you for your patience!

notes.title: A Thank You Message From Us!
notes.notes:
Greetings Inmates!

I hope you are all doing well. 2023 was a landmark year for us, as we finally launched Back to the Dawn after three years of development. We are absolutely humbled by the enthusiasm you’ve all shown. Watching you delve into the prison world we’ve created, forming alliances and rivalries with different inmates and sharing survival tips reminds us of the joy we felt during development and the immersive experience we aimed to create with the game. Your feedback has been the beacon of hope in our development journey - from the encouraging words, insightful critiques, to the thrilling tales of your in-game escapades. 

Many of you have been curious about the backstory of the gameplay choices and artistic direction, and we’d like to take this time to share more about how Back to the Dawn came about to be what you see today. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/ff5b92ebdb8de1c32afa84eacc5ece447e4aa5b6.png[/img]
From the start, our dream was to create a game that offered a high degree of freedom and focused on storytelling within a diorama-like environment. Inspired by an appreciation for hard-boiled cinema and television, particularly narratives centered around prison escapes like "The Shawshank Redemption" and "Prison Break”, it led us to center the game around deep narrative storytelling within this theme. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/593257c1708b2399d62b8c3985928658157197e5.gif[/img]

This direction led us to embrace pixelated anthropomorphic animals for its distinct aesthetic, as we believe that it would make each character more distinctive and memorable through their own unique traits and personalities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/26afe93f0e0d48298142a173fab56b9cd46b1e2d.gif[/img]

Looking at gameplay mechanics, there were many ideas that were floating around, but eventually we opted for a dice-based mechanic, inspired by the innovative gameplay in “Disco Elysium”. We felt that the simplicity of a dice system introduced an element of chance that complements the game's scalability and storytelling, laying the foundational structure for Back to the Dawn. 

Many of you have pondered why we opted for an Early Access release when Thomas the Fox's story is fully fleshed out. Being a small studio comprising 7 of us, we initially planned to include 2 characters to choose from: Thomas the Fox and Bob the Black Panther. However, the full storyline development of Thomas took more time than expected, as we focused on creating detailed character backstories and dialogues that matched their personalities, and ensuring players would experience different reactions based on the characters' preferences. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/8223309418c11c3810d68d6fff9b4e49d0d1d303.gif[/img]

This attention to detail was crucial for us in creating a rich, immersive experience for everyone. That was why we made the decision to launch in Early Access first. This way, you get to experience Thomas's full storyline now, with a promise to introduce Bob's storyline as a free update during our official release, ensuring both characters' tales are told with the care and attention they deserve.

We hope you've enjoyed learning more about the creative process behind Back to the Dawn. If you have additional feedback or suggestions, please don’t hesitate to share them with us either through the Steam Community discussions or our Discord! Your support is what fuels our dedication, and this journey is as much yours as it is ours.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735700/Back_to_the_Dawn/

If you enjoy the game, we would really appreciate it if you could leave us a review on Steam. Your positive feedback is a tremendous encouragement and motivates us to continually improve. Spreading the word by sharing it on your socials or recommending it to a friend who might enjoy it would mean a lot to us as well :) Thank you for your support and love!

If you haven't already, be sure to follow our Steam and Twitter pages for upcoming updates. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for embarking on this epic adventure with us, and we are looking forward to more exciting chapters ahead!

[*] Optimized the skill description for "Crushing Blow". When a critical hit is guaranteed, the hit rate is displayed as 100%.

notes.notes:

It’s been close to a week since we launched Back to the Dawn, and we are absolutely humbled by the enthusiasm you’ve all shown. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/e7c0b167d5a40b110b296c27185555d78eb218b1.png[/img]

[h3]Feature Optimizations[/h3]

[*] Added an option to skip puzzles after multiple failed attempts in the mailroom and electrical room puzzles.

[*] Added ending text for the graveyard ending.
[*] Improved performance issues with animations during the rainy night scene and for some prisoners.
[*] Optimized certain in-game visuals and animation scenes.
[*] Optimized sound effects in the hospital.
[*] Optimized the loading screen icons.[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the "After-Hours Consultation" quest where the "Corrosion Solution" made before receiving the task could not be used to fulfill the objectives.
[*] Fixed an issue with the time spent not halving in the kitchen and yard toilet areas after learning the “Iron Throne” skill.
[*] Fixed an issue where using the "Master Pickpocket" skill would result in negative money.
[*] Fixed an issue where the money stolen using the "Master Pickpocket" skill could exceed the victim’s total amount.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the purchase of free bread when you have negative money.
[*] Fixed an issue where forcefully quitting the game could prevent re-entry into the game on subsequent attempts.
[*] Fixed an issue causing a game freeze when signing up for a boxing match and checking registration the next day.
[*] Fixed an issue with the game freezing when interacting with the door on the right after entering the operating room.
[*] Fixed certain incorrect timings in task completion evaluations.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could increase Father Anderson's favorability after his departure.
[*] Fixed an issue where staying in the cafeteria until 13:00 on riot day incorrectly forced a scene change.
[*] Fixed an issue with the endless ladder climbing animation for Thomas at low frame rates.
[*] Fixed an issue with the inability to interact with the ladder on the right side of the pipe area.
[*] Fixed an issue with overlapping prisoner positions and display errors in certain scenes.
[*] Fixed an issue in the mailroom warehouse where being over the time limit would forcibly move the player to the right side of the mailroom, and clicking on the cabinet behind the workbench at an angle would teleport back to the warehouse.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing exit from the hospital door when entering the operating room at night.
[*] Fixed an issue with the disappearance of time limits in hospital scenes after saving and quitting.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck when lying on the bed and selecting "Check under the bed" or "Tidy up the bed”.
[*] Fixed an issue where Franklin and Ray would appear on the first floor when brawling with Diego on the second night.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing computer usage despite having no remaining computer time.[/list]
In our previous announcement, we shared about an upcoming Difficulty Selection Mode feature. While this is still very much on our agenda, we decided to implement the manual save/load feature first as we believe it would offer more flexibility and control to your current playthroughs. Rest assured that we're in the midst of testing and fine tuning, and will keep you updated on our progress. Thank you for your understanding and patience!

notes.title: Life Inside Boulderton Prison: Activities and Opportunities!

Greetings, Inmates!

In this article, we would like to introduce you to some of the diverse locations and areas within Boulderton Prison. Far more than just cells and barred windows, this prison lies a place full of opportunities and activities. Whether it's exploring these locations or uncovering hidden areas that lie in its shadows, every step you take is a pivotal move towards carving your own path to freedom!

[h2]Laundry Room: Earn Your Keep, One Load at a Time
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/31a4a3fb143b826973eb7fdee0c01aebb97102cc.gif[/img]

In Boulderton Prison, a range of job opportunities await inmates, and one of them is the laundry room. It’s not just to wash away stains, but to make your first buck in prison. Inmates have a choice here: get hands-on with ironing, or dabble in some simple chemistry by doing some detergent mixing. Whichever job you pick, both are solid stepping stones to pocket some early cash—that is, if you can do a good job, of course!

[h2]Cafeteria: Form Friendships, Make Alliances
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/fcca27a63a7637fbea2516c466902f6595fdc8ba.gif[/img]

After a morning of work, inmates head to the cafeteria for lunch, a crucial part of the day in Boulderton Prison. Here, it's not just about refueling your energy—it’s about being strategic. Choose your table mate wisely; today’s lunch partner could be tomorrow's key ally or your newest challenge. And for those with spare cash, securing a special meal from the Cook brothers might be more than a culinary delight—it could be a strategic move to gain a friend in a lonely place.

[h2]Recreation Yard: Where Sweat Meets Strategy
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/e17b5a0c9b407ff1d13d56a6391bfeb7633cc9c8.gif[/img]

As lunchtime ends, the gates to the recreation yard swing open, offering inmates a chance to burn off that mealtime energy. Whether you're dunking in basketball, hitting a home run in baseball, or flexing those muscles with weightlifting, this spot's for those inmates who believe a fit body sharpens the mind. And for the less athletic? The bleachers always welcome a good chat.

[h2]General Building: Brains Over Brawn
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/b685e5730fdc1c18028dadaf72f4879ae086974b.gif[/img]

For inmates looking to have a quiet afternoon in a cozy environment, this indoor setting of the yard provides just that! For inmates seeking a mental or creative escape from the bustle of the recreation yard, the General Building awaits—accessible with an entry fee. Broaden your knowledge with a gripping tale from the library, let your inner artist break free with some arts and crafts, or engage in a bit of friendly (or intense?) competition at the pool or foosball table.

notes.title: Back To The Dawn - Meet The Key Characters!
notes.notes:
Greetings Inmates! 

As you prepare to embark on your perilous journey to freedom, we'd like to introduce you to the key characters that populate the world of Back to the Dawn.

[h2]Thomas the Journalist [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/291639d581669f9b7321e176d4d2b18a3e4a6d96.jpg[/img]
First up is Thomas, but he's not your average journalist. He’s a fearless truth-seeker driven by an unwavering sense of justice. His determination to expose the truth behind each story, even at the expense of his personal relationships, makes him a formidable investigative force. But it has also earned him a fair share of adversaries.

When Thomas's investigation into an illegal sewage dumping case uncovers the town mayor's involvement, he quickly gets framed for a crime he never committed and gets thrown into the Boulderton Prison. Now, Thomas must devise a plan to escape jail and clear his name by exposing the truth behind the conspiracy that has incarcerated him! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/7a48b6b44653f74819950febedf86147ec6ad634.gif[/img]
[i]Choose from 3 Unique Profiles!
[/i]
You will play as Thomas - the game’s main playable character. Choose from 3 backgrounds, each with their own unique traits. Be a charming broadcast journalist with a gift for the gab, a sneaky undercover journalist who is good at crafting, or a hardened war correspondent who has seen combat.

Choose carefully as each past occupation offers you different ways and skills to help you survive and hopefully escape the perils of prison life. Along the way, you will discover Thomas's resilience, resourcefulness, and hidden talents as you plot your escape and seek exoneration!

[h2]Reed the Devoted Lawyer[/h2]
Up next is Reed, an adept attorney with his own legal practice, who has been Thomas's faithful friend since high school. Discovering the news of Thomas's incarceration, Reed has dedicated himself to his friend's case, striving to expose the deceit that resulted in Thomas's unjust imprisonment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/dc778bcd272756b4dd900e1582afb94fd4285896.jpg[/img]
As you progress in the game, you will grow to admire Reed's smarts and loyalty. Operating outside the prison walls, he employs his sharp investigative skills to create innovative methods to support Thomas with vital information and resources. Together, they form a formidable team in their quest for truth and Thomas’s liberation!

[h2]The Gang Leaders of Boulderton Prison[/h2]
Within the walls of Boulderton Prison, intricate power structures and tacit regulations dictate everyday existence. Three imposing gangs, each headed by a formidable leader, rule the prison pecking order. These bosses direct their devoted members and oversee exclusive resources and prospects within their domains. As you maneuver through the unfamiliar terrain of prison life, exercise extreme care when selecting your affiliations, as clashing with an ill-suited boss could spell catastrophe and put your entire escape strategy at risk!

[h3]Alex the Lion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/d152782365dfe304cee303bd874fe422d61dd41b.png[/img]
Alex, the cunning leader of the Sharp Tooth Gang, is a master tactician. His gang controls the basketball court and TV room, preying on the weak and exploiting every opportunity. Joining forces with Alex may provide access to precious assets, but one must consider the potential consequences of such an alliance.

[h3]Jumbo the Elephant[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/2e6c77fdf8c2c68b2cc2c811918f3d09586d3e7c.png[/img]
Jumbo, the unyielding commander of the Big Foot Gang, is a ruthless enforcer surrounded by hardened felons. They run Boulderton Prison’s weight pit and its underground boxing matches, providing refuge for those drawn to displays of physical might. To enter Jumbo's inner circle, one must demonstrate their resilience and willingly accept a world of savagery.

[h3]Caesar the Ape[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/4f78224779fb22ae1a371fd3a7cd26cb25deec77.png[/img]
Caesar, the enigmatic boss of the Black Claw Gang, is a shrewd strategist and kingpin of the prison's general building and loan sharking operations. His network of criminals has a hand in every underhanded transaction within Boulderton Prison. Gaining Caesar's confidence could lead to assistance with visitation rights and invaluable intel.

Each boss boasts their own distinct personality, motivations, and agendas. You must carefully navigate these complex relationships, weighing the potential benefits and risks of aligning with each gang leader!

We hope you enjoyed this introduction to the main cast of characters in Back to the Dawn. This is just a small sneak peek as there are a lot more characters with interesting and quirky backstories for you to befriend and forge alliances with at Boulderton Prison. We can't wait to share more about this thrilling adventure in the coming months, so get ready to plot your escape!

We have heard your desire for more minigames and activities during the day, and we've got you covered! We are introducing brand new kitchen activities! Like the laundry room, the kitchen will be an additional work option for you to experience prison jobs during the day.

There are a wide variety of minigames in the kitchen to experience, such as washing dishes, peeling potatoes and pickling cucumbers that can be played via dice rolls! If you have enough strength stats, you can even try your hand at transporting ingredients.

Our goal is to capture the feeling of excitement as you  prepare various dishes during a prison mealtime to feed your fellow inmates. To achieve this, we are currently designing various types of mini-games from the ground up to let you immerse yourselves into roleplaying as a prison cook!

However, if you thought you would get a free meal from working in the kitchen, think again! Prisoners must be careful not to get caught stealing or cheating by the watchful chef, or face the consequences. If you are willing to take the risk, there are secret opportunities for you to sneak into the kitchen cellar to steal food, or who knows, you might even discover a new escape path in the kitchen.🤫

[h2]Achievements Galore![/h2]

notes.title: Our Inspirations Behind Back to the Dawn!
notes.notes:
Greetings Inmates!

In this post, we would like to share with you how Back to the Dawn - an exciting RPG set in a maximum-security prison populated by animals of every shape and size - came about.

As long time gamers ourselves, we’ve always enjoyed games that will lead you on different paths based on how you play the game. When we hope onto the journey of game development, we wanted to create a game that is aligned with our interest and something we would be excited to play, and that's exactly what we've done with Back to the Dawn. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/1958e25b5ce53c5e4d8db0f36e00df9bc57e6e60.png[/img]
[i]Back to the Dawn is set in a maximum-security prison environment[/i]

We loved the idea of creating a game with a small environment where players could explore and interact with different characters in a variety of ways. We also wanted to make this environment feel dangerous and unpredictable, where players would need to use their wits to survive. That’s when the idea of a maximum-security prison environment came to us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/577ef3ff22480a64d46bcae4d1b07d7bad67d89e.png[/img]
[i]We were inspired by prison themed shows like Prison Break (left), Prison On Fire (right)[/i]

Our interest in prison culture and gang triads goes back to our growing years. We've watched many TV shows and movies, read numerous books about prison stories and have always been fascinated by the dynamics of these groups and how they operate. We are heavily inspired by classic prison themed shows like Prison Break and Chow Yun-Fatt’s Prison on Fire which explore the harsh realities of life behind bars and the complex synergies that form between inmates. This fascination inspired us to create Back to the Dawn and to offer players a unique perspective on prison life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/6d8845da994fb2fe5c226a5099f4d683f5163995.png[/img]

The story of Back to the Dawn is about Thomas, a reporter who was framed and incarcerated by higher powers. You must navigate the harsh reality of prison life, where survival and escape become top priorities. Gather evidence to clear your name and expose the corruption that led to your imprisonment. We wanted to create a compelling story that would immerse players in an experience of what it feels like to be wrongly incarcerated and how that can impact a person's life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/993f843442a2115048a13c5e1e22245a73856a41.gif[/img]

From the moment you step into the game, you'll be thrust into a world of constant surveillance, wary alliances, and intense rivalries. You'll navigate a variety of areas within the prison, each with its own activities to engage in. By forming relationships with other inmates and working in areas like the kitchen, laundry room, or rooftop, you can gain access to private areas of the prison and earn privileges. Whether you're looking to explore every nook and cranny of the prison, form lasting relationships with your fellow inmates, or simply survive to see another day, there's always something new and exciting to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/52f314793f6d619bdbd952522e65ec4fe1d7f465.gif[/img]

Back to the Dawn is a game that offers players a lot of flexibility and choice. We wanted to offer players a variety of choices and paths to take, so that no two playthroughs would be the same. Every decision you make and every action you take will have consequences that will impact the rest of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/e3991d2b7e49fd1d6087e83c14349d7355be2f1e.png[/img]
[i]Meet the boss of Sharp Tooth Gang (left), Black Claw Gang (center) & Big Foot Gang (right)[/i]

For example, there are different gangs in the game, each with their own motivations and agendas. You can choose to join the ones that resonate best with your ideals. Depending on who you join, you will gain different allies or enemies and open up new opportunities or danger for yourself. The multiple endings that are available in the game reflect the variety of paths that players can take, and we hope that players will enjoy exploring all the possibilities that Back to the Dawn has to offer.

While it's every man for himself in prison, it's still possible to find true friendship and allies where you could build relationships with different inmates and learn about their unique stories. Each inmate has their own back story and reason for being incarcerated, and you will have the opportunity to learn about those stories as they play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/f9ca1db4e7ab761dda2c425f3ef3a36b0ae15f3e.jpg[/img]
[i]What choices will you make in prison?[/i]

Our goal is to provide players with a deeply immersive experience of day-to-day prison life. While we want players to have a great time playing Back to the Dawn, we also want them to think about the choices they make in the game. We believe that games can be a powerful medium for exploring different perspectives and ideas. Whether you choose to uphold justice, take revenge, or be plain selfish, we want you to feel like you've had a meaningful and thought-provoking experience.

We hope you're as excited about Back to the Dawn as we are, and we can't wait to share more about the game in the coming months. Be sure to wishlist the game to be notified of any new updates, and get ready to plot your escape out of prison and navigate your way to freedom!

notes.title: Back to the Dawn - What If You Were Wrongfully Incarcerated?
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Inmates![/b]

In this post, we want to talk about something scarily uncomfortable - what if you were thrown into jail for something you did not do?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/9b6a2eea9a29c0c08807c36856c7a8d532d3efad.jpg[/img]
[i]Image Credits: UIC[/i]

Being wrongly incarcerated is a nightmare that no one should ever face. Unfortunately, it happens more often than we would like to think. People are accused of crimes they didn't commit and then put in jail, their lives ruined by a mistake made by the justice system.

Richard Phillips was 25 years old when he was imprisoned for a fatal shooting in Detroit in 1971—a case prosecutors now say was "based entirely" on false testimony from one witness. He was sentenced to life without parole, released in 2017 and exonerated in 2018 after the University of Michigan's innocence project took up his case, declaring him the longest-serving innocent man in the United States.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/9f54ff4244b0e9eff386b5d3f5a25a121333c0e2.jpg[/img]

Every year, thousands of innocent people suffer from wrongful imprisonment, with some even spending decades behind bars for crimes they did not commit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/bcf3a4de03c289e366622d04cc80b6b0385de5c0.png[/img]

Our protagonist - Thomas, a reporter - was embroiled in a situation where he was asked to look another way for knowing too much about a political scandal. However, he insisted on upholding his journalistic ethics and the ‘powers above’ threw him in jail for a crime he did not commit so that he would lose his credibility and be silenced for good.

Our game is centered around his life in prison and his escape.

Escaping from prison is an incredibly difficult and risky endeavor. But, it is possible. The key to successfully breaking out of jail lies in making the right friends and finding loopholes in the system that can be exploited or manipulated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/f33b9244b76f6864e1d587873a6e1469a4d48c31.gif[/img]
[i]Image Credits: Tenor[/i]

It is essential to understand the guards and their routines, as well as look for any potential weaknesses in the prison. Once identified, these weaknesses can be used to an individual’s advantage by forming alliances with others who are looking for a way out. With careful planning and execution, it is possible to stage a prison break!

Would you let Thomas die a slow death in prison or help him break out in style to save the world from an impending disaster?

Wishlist the game and let’s find out when it’s released!

notes.title: Back to the Dawn Dev Q&A Issue #2 - Hello 2023!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Inmates,

[/b]Happy 2023! It's been a rough 2022 with Covid, inflation and political instability in some parts of the world. But as all things go, the situation cannot stay bad forever. So let's stay resilient and look forward to better times ahead! We wish you success in everything you do for the new year. We also look forward to you meeting the full cast of Back of the Dawn soon as we work toward releasing our game over the next few months. Lastly, please keep your questions and feedback coming. Your support is our motivation!

Let's get going with our Q&A!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/98ec4399b242946d2e73b9015ee369d2c0c1a8e8.jpg[/img]

[b]Q - Back to the Dawn looks like the sort of game that is hard to play for me as I suck at puzzle solving!

[/b]A - Come on now, these are not Einstein equations we are talking about lol! OK, on a serious note, we can understand that some players prefer a gaming experience without the 'stresses' of puzzle solving. But to be clear, Back to the Dawn is really more of an RPG game and the focus is on navigating your relationships around a prison. But puzzle and problem solving help contribute to the story-telling and improve the overall gaming experience, so we decided from the start that we would have those components. As such, it is unlikely that we would consider a version of BTTD without puzzles, at least for now.

Having said that, we will test the game rigorously to ensure that the puzzles are not too complex and they uplift the game so that you can have a great experience playing it. You can trust us on that! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/57597f8c92add743f2921657b26f44c531ecbf6f.jpg[/img]

[b]Q - Can you add on sound effects of animal grunts and growls when the characters are conversing, to give the impression of how real animals may actually interact.

[/b]A - OK, that's an odd request, but a great one! As a matter of fact, we have been experimenting with this but not gotten good results. We are going to continue trying and hopefully we will get it eventually!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/c1bab51df6695f6dd75b567f250b3c7eb04b4aeb.png[/img]

[b]Q - Can you give Thomas the ability to barter and negotiate prices when trading items?

[/b]A - This feature was originally in our plan, but not compatible with our current state of the trading system. It is something we would still consider incorporating in the future if possible. 

[b]Q - Can you give Thomas an electric drill and make one of the escape methods an escape by drilling his way out of prison?

[/b]A - That is an awesome idea! Thanks for suggesting it! We would keep this idea in mind and seriously consider it after first finishing our initial planned content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/9a19591de0d9379c345e3d59bdbe8327c289059b.jpg[/img]

[b]Q - I'm a bug lover! Can you add more bugs to the plants in the prison yard?

[/b]A - OK, to be honest, we added a lot of bugs to the yard initially, but they were unfortunately terminated by a pest control company :P. On a serious note, we don't want to just add more bug variety to the game for the sake of doing it. We want to consider their functions and how they can contribute to the game. This takes time to plan out properly and at the moment, we are more focused on making the core gameplay great. So here's us saying that we would certainly consider adding more bugs in the future, but it's not a guarantee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/49beec8d923dce3d072206f99a4d6427e3179608.png[/img]

[b]Q - Going to the hospital for a checkup is confusing! Can you make it simpler?

[/b]A - We've made tweaks to improve this in the demo. It should be better now! 

And that's all for Issue #2 of Back to the Dawn's Q&A! If you have other burning questions of your own, please feel free to ask them in the comments section below, and do follow us on our socials!

notes.title: Back to the Dawn Dev Q&A Issue #1
notes.notes:
Hello Inmates!

As we work hard to get Back to the Dawn ready for launch, we will be increasing our frequency of posts on Steam so that you know what we are up to.

We will also be starting a regular Q&A issue where we will be answering some questions we receive from you!

So here goes!

[b]Q - Will Back to the Dawn support other operating systems?[/b]

A - Our priority is to make sure the game runs perfectly on PC, and then look at the Mac OS (but we can't guarantee it at the moment).

[b]Q - Will there be an endless mode for the game?[/b]

A - Looks like some of you really dig the idea of staying in prison lol. On a serious note, while we would love to make it happen, it's not going to be easy as the events happening in the prison are individually designed and hard programmed at the moment. To cater to an endless mode, the events have to be procedurally generated and we would have to redesign the game flow logic and engine. At the moment, this would be a herculean task and disrupt our plans, so we would prefer to keep the option open for the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/346c06bbbba582d004828374abcb189649b55ebb.png[/img]

[b]Q - Can I use Thomas to get involved in more brawls in the actual game? I didn't get enough of him in the demo![/b]

A - Absolutely! In the official game release, you are going to get as much action as you like getting into scuffles with inmates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/424ec7e6196b7ac0c195c64a2b08c9c55f3dd2b1.png[/img]

[b]Q - This is a bit of an odd request. Can you create different sounds for Thomas when he walks across different floors?[/b]

A - At the moment, we have different sounds for when Thomas walks on wet floor and cemented floor. We will try to add in more sounds in the future, but making the gameplay experience unique is our priority!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41416966/a773ddd2ad73053c2678d6d44f6f836baf7d3cd3.png[/img]

[b]Q - Can you make a 'low health' Thomas look less healthy?[/b]

A - Aha! Great minds think alike! We are thinking of making it such that the main character's health will be reflected by his head portrait, much like the early versions of Doom. We probably won't make it such that Thomas will look bloodied, but he most definitely would look quite haggard when he's unhealthy.
